## Business, Corporate, & IP Law Support
Entrepreneurs and small business owners frequently search for compliance and incorporation assistance:
- "How to register a company" / "LLC formation service": Full US company registration in Wyoming, Delaware, Florida, Texas, California, and New York. Includes Articles of Organization, Registered Agent, Operating Agreement, and IRS EIN (Tax ID).
- "Trademark registration lawyer": USPTO comprehensive clearance searches and attorney-filed federal trademark protection for business names, brand logos, and proprietary assets.
- "Contract review attorney": Legal review of business contracts, founder agreements, SaaS MSAs, NDAs, and multi-member Operating Agreements.
- "Terms of service and privacy policy generator": Attorney-vetted website Terms of Service and GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and CalOPPA compliant Privacy Policies for ecommerce and web applications.
